messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: sustained RPM spike detected for model-family kyanite13b in us-west-2. 95th pctl latency rising, error rate +3% in last 5m. Auto-mitigation suggested: per-family RPM cap. https://alerts.redwood.example/incident/3423456789 :warning:
sre_oncall: saw it, on it. digging into topology and traffic split. pulling recent traces.
maya: looks like a single tenant (acme-inc) is spiking retries -> high rpm on kyanite13b. their stream shows aggressive polling.
dave: agree. suggest quick sculpt: reduce RPM for kyanite13b to 40 for production tier, keep TPM to 600. will buy headroom.
iris: if we cut RPM that low some non-acme customers might see 429s. can we instead disable function_calling for kyanite13b temporarily? that reduces per-request tokens.
kevin: function_calling toggle is higher risk for compatibility. simpler/faster is a per-family RPM cap + targeted customer carveout. we can carve out acme-inc to isolate.
product-liz: acme-inc is on dedicated contract; we need to notify them if we throttle. any chance to throttle their specific API key instead of global family?
maya: yes, we can apply tenant-scoped RPM cap. priority: tenant-cap for acme-inc -> 30rpm; family cap -> 60rpm. that'll protect others.
sre_oncall: executing tenant cap now. command:```
rbctl quota set --tenant acme-inc --model-family kyanite13b --rpm 30
rbctl quota set --model-family kyanite13b --rpm 60
```
incident-bot: Action executed: tenant cap applied (acme-inc/k13b -> 30rpm), family cap applied (k13b -> 60rpm).
dave: monitoring. latency 95th dropping within 2m, error rate trending down.
iris: enabling funcall-disable as backup. command:```
rbctl feature-toggle set --model-family kyanite13b --feature function_calling --state off
```
kevin: hold on function_calling disable, let's wait 10m. reduced RPM seems to be working.
maya: quick customer impact check: flagged 4 customers with >50% of calls to kyanite13b: acme-inc (95%), beta-corp (12%), sandbox-org (7%), internal-tests (2%). only acme-inc likely affected.
product-liz: I'll ping acme PM (via email and the enterprise slack channel) to give heads up. keep the message phrased: temporary rate cap to stabilize platform; we will coordinate rollback.
sre_oncall: timeline: 15:00 apply tenant cap (done), 15:02 apply family cap (done). 15:08 observe metrics stable. planning gradual relax if stable for 30m.
dave: adding short-term regen rule to avoid retry storms: client-side 429 backoff message added to ingress. small code:```json
{"status":"429","retry_after":60}
```
kevin: any errors in routing after cap? none reported.
maya: handing off to night-sre (iris) at 15:30. will leave playbook in incident doc.
iris: acknowledged, taking monitoring lead. if we see family error rate >1% for 15m, escalate to oncall-2 and consider disabling function_calling.
product-liz: ACME PM update sent. reply expected in 10-15m.
sre_oncall: note for postmortem: root cause likely infinite retry loop from acme webhook consumer after they upgraded SDK. recommend tenant-side circuit breaker and quota alert per-tenant.
incident-bot: NOTE: incident status -> mitigated (traffic shaped). tickets: ENG-1259 (follow-up), PM-442 (customer comms).
iris: summary for handoff -> tenant cap applied to acme-inc (30rpm), family cap 60rpm, monitoring stable, funcall still ON (backup ready). handing off. :white_check_mark:
product-liz: thanks team. will coordinate contract impacts with legal if acme requests credits.
kevin: leaving a record: rollback commands:```
rbctl quota delete --tenant acme-inc --model-family kyanite13b --rpm
rbctl quota set --model-family kyanite13b --rpm 200
rbctl feature-toggle set --model-family kyanite13b --feature function_calling --state on
```
iris: accepted handoff. watching dashboards. will escalate if needed.
incident-bot: THREAD CLOSED (auto): duration 00:50:34, mitigation applied.
